llmModelConfigDesc: Configure the AI language model used for chat, summaries, keyword extraction, etc.
embeddingModelConfigDesc: Configure the Embedding model used for vector search and knowledge base retrieval. Embedding and LLM can use different providers and API keys.
deleteKeyConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this API key?
aboutDescription: AI Note Keeper is an AI-powered personal knowledge base with multi-provider support. LLM and Embedding models can be configured independently.
configureLlmApiKeys: Configure API keys for LLM providers. Keys are stored securely in the database and can also be set via environment variables.
configureEmbeddingApiKeys: Configure API keys for Embedding providers. Embedding uses separate API keys and can use different providers than LLM.
